## Who We Are

### In a world increasingly defined by access to connectivity,

Comtech is pushing the limits of innovation to deliver next-generation communications technologies
to power the connections that matter most.

Our innovative solutions ensure the **resilience** and **continuity** of the mission-critical
communications systems that underpin public safety, global security, supply chains, public
infrastructure, and everyday life.

Our Satellite and Space Communications segment delivers the resilient, secure, all-domain
communications solutions needed to support today’s military missions, critical infrastructure, and

life-saving solutions that help public safety professionals and essential service providers succeed
– when every connection counts.

### Comtech applies over a half-century of proven technologies,

NexusWave

Fully managed bonded connectivity solution (GEO Ka-band + LEO + LTE + L-band) for an office-like and
home-like internet experience at sea.

Fleet Xpress

Fleet Xpress continues to offer dependable, managed connectivity services backed by Inmarsat’s
expertise. This proven connectivity service provides valuable support for day-to-day operations and
crew welfare.

Safety

Safety is in our DNA – established in 1979 by the International Maritime Organization (IMO) to
deliver dependable satellite safety communications.

Narrowband

For those fleets that don’t need the power of digitalisation or a high-speed crew internet service
just yet, narrowband remains a cost-efficient solution to keep your vessel connected.

investing in our high-capacity satellite network and value-added services to give shipowners and
operators the certainty they need - from safety and business-critical applications to operational
efficiency and keeping crews connected with loved ones.

NexusWave

Fully managed bonded connectivity solution (GEO Ka-band + LEO + LTE + L-band) for an office-like and
home-like internet experience at sea.

Fleet Xpress

Fleet Xpress continues to offer dependable, managed connectivity services backed by Inmarsat’s
expertise. This proven connectivity service provides valuable support for day-to-day operations and
crew welfare.

Safety

Safety is in our DNA – established in 1979 by the International Maritime Organization (IMO) to
deliver dependable satellite safety communications.

Narrowband

For those fleets that don’t need the power of digitalisation or a high-speed crew internet service
just yet, narrowband remains a cost-efficient solution to keep your vessel connected.

As the world’s largest combined GEO/MEO operator—with strategic access to LEO—we’re building a new
era of multi-orbit, multi-band connectivity. We deliver unprecedented flexibility, resilience, and
performance so government, aviation, and enterprise customers can operate with greater reliability,
speed and reach.

Watch how SES is shaping the future of our industry.

> The Q1 results reflect the lower level of commercial aircraft deliveries and a strong performance
> in our Defence and Space division. The operating environment remains dynamic and complex. We are
> closely monitoring the potential impact from the fast-changing situation in the Middle East. In
> commercial aircraft, we continue to ramp up and produce as per our plan while navigating the
> shortage of Pratt & Whitney engines.

## Latest News

[Port Administration of American Samoa and ATLAS Space Operations Finalize Agreement for New
Satellite Ground Station]

### [Port Administration of American Samoa and ATLAS Space Operations Finalize Agreement for New
### Satellite Ground Station][101]

The Port Administration of American Samoa will host advanced satellite tracking antennas for ATLAS
Space Operations, enhancing satellite ground-station services in the South Pacific. This partnership
supports NOAA and military clients, improves real-time data coverage, and contributes to local
infrastructure funding. Construction began on March 2, 2026.
[ Read More ][102]
* [ March 10, 2026 ][103]
[The Ground Software Crisis: Why We Must Redefine Our Infrastructure or Sabotage the Future]

### [The Ground Software Crisis: Why We Must Redefine Our Infrastructure or Sabotage the
### Future][104]

The space industry faces a critical issue where ground software engineering contracts are often
awarded to companies lacking the necessary expertise in ground systems. This misallocation results
in poorly designed systems and high maintenance costs. To resolve this, ground systems must be
recognized as essential infrastructure, demanding dedicated expertise and a clean architectural
approach.
[ Read More ][105]
* [ December 11, 2025 ][106]
[NorthBase joins the ATLAS Space Operations’ Freedom Network]

### [NorthBase Joins the ATLAS Space Operations’ Freedom Network][107]

Finnish NewSpace company NorthBase and ATLAS Space Operations have partnered to enhance satellite
ground station services in Finnish Lapland. The new NorthBase Muonio site joins the ATLAS Freedom
network, improving global antenna access and providing significant coverage capabilities, especially
with the 3.9 meter S/X band antenna in a secure location.
[ Read More ][108]
* [ July 29, 2025 ][109]
[ATLAS Space Operations to be Acquired, Creating a New Chapter for Traverse City’s Space Innovator]

### [ATLAS Space Operations to be Acquired, Creating a New Chapter for Traverse City’s Space
### Innovator][110]

ATLAS Space Operations, a leading GSaaS provider for satellite communications, is to be acquired by
York Space Systems, marking a significant milestone for its founders and investors. The acquisition,
pending FCC approval, aims to enhance growth, job creation, and innovation within the Traverse City
community while maintaining ATLAS's operations and brand.
[ Read More ][111]

## Latest News

[Port Administration of American Samoa and ATLAS Space Operations Finalize Agreement for New
Satellite Ground Station]

### [Port Administration of American Samoa and ATLAS Space Operations Finalize Agreement for New
### Satellite Ground Station][101]

The Port Administration of American Samoa will host advanced satellite tracking antennas for ATLAS
Space Operations, enhancing satellite ground-station services in the South Pacific. This partnership
supports NOAA and military clients, improves real-time data coverage, and contributes to local
infrastructure funding. Construction began on March 2, 2026.
[ Read More ][102]
* [ March 10, 2026 ][103]
[The Ground Software Crisis: Why We Must Redefine Our Infrastructure or Sabotage the Future]

### [The Ground Software Crisis: Why We Must Redefine Our Infrastructure or Sabotage the
### Future][104]

The space industry faces a critical issue where ground software engineering contracts are often
awarded to companies lacking the necessary expertise in ground systems. This misallocation results
in poorly designed systems and high maintenance costs. To resolve this, ground systems must be
recognized as essential infrastructure, demanding dedicated expertise and a clean architectural
approach.
[ Read More ][105]
* [ December 11, 2025 ][106]
[NorthBase joins the ATLAS Space Operations’ Freedom Network]

### [NorthBase Joins the ATLAS Space Operations’ Freedom Network][107]

Finnish NewSpace company NorthBase and ATLAS Space Operations have partnered to enhance satellite
ground station services in Finnish Lapland. The new NorthBase Muonio site joins the ATLAS Freedom
network, improving global antenna access and providing significant coverage capabilities, especially
with the 3.9 meter S/X band antenna in a secure location.
[ Read More ][108]
* [ July 29, 2025 ][109]
[ATLAS Space Operations to be Acquired, Creating a New Chapter for Traverse City’s Space Innovator]

### [ATLAS Space Operations to be Acquired, Creating a New Chapter for Traverse City’s Space
### Innovator][110]

ATLAS Space Operations, a leading GSaaS provider for satellite communications, is to be acquired by
York Space Systems, marking a significant milestone for its founders and investors. The acquisition,
pending FCC approval, aims to enhance growth, job creation, and innovation within the Traverse City
community while maintaining ATLAS's operations and brand.
[ Read More ][111]

# We ensure your satellite works perfectly

We are your partner in satellite testing, simulation and communication

[ Talk to our experts ][76]
Our services

## C-STS: Trustworthy Engineering for Tailor-Made Solutions in Simulation, Testing, and
## Communication

With over three decades of experience, Celestia STS (C-STS) is a trusted name in the European and
international space industry. Since our founding in 1985, we have specialized in delivering
ground-based solutions for satellite simulation, testing, communication, and data processing.

As a center of excellence for Electrical Ground Support Equipment ([EGSE][77]), [TT&C solutions][78]
and [Optical Modems][79], we have earned an outstanding reputation for flexibility and high-quality
engineering. Our systems are vital to a wide range of space missions and are used in diverse
environments—from institutional laboratories and spacecraft integration facilities to operational
(optical) ground stations for missions like Galileo, [EAGLE-1][80] and the ESA Copernicus
satellites.

Our legacy is built on a history of success, having contributed to over 80% of major European Space
Agency missions. As we continue to expand and innovate, our dedicated team is committed to
delivering the reliable, high-performance solutions that ensure your satellite works perfectly.

[more about us][81]

#### Electronic Ground Support Equipment (EGSE)

[ On-Board Interfaces ][82] [ RF Interfaces ][83] [ Integrated Systems ][84] [ Software ][85]

#### Ground Station Equipment

[ TT&C Modem ][86] [ TT&C Processor ][87] [ Optical Modem ][88]
Highlighted products

## Multi-Purpose Interface Platform

A modular and scalable electrical ground support equipment (EGSE) that enables space equipment
builders and integrators to test and simulate spacecraft electrical and data interfaces in a fast,
flexible and cost-efficient manner.

[Discover product][89]
[Multi Purpose Interface Platform MPIP back Celestia-STS C-STS]
Highlighted products

## Optical Modem

Reception and processing functionality of digital bitstreams output by free-space optical (FSO)
receiver modules.
Capable of receiving data rates of up to 10Gbps.

[Discover product][90]
[Front Optical Modem Celestia-STS C-STS]
Highlighted products

## WizardLink Front-End

Provides high-speed serial interfaces to spacecraft flight equipment to test and validate satellite
flight equipment.

[Discover product][91]
[wizardlink front-end unit Celestia-STS C-STS frontside 3D]
About Celestia STS

## Celestia STS provides comprehensive solutions for satellite development and mission operations.

[Learn more about us][92]

## Celestia Group

Celestia STS is a [Celestia Group][93] company.

The [Celestia Group companies][94] operate across the globe but share a common purpose. Together, we
exist to lead the continuous search for cutting-edge solutions with reliable, affordable, European
made high technology.

# We ensure your satellite works perfectly

We are your partner in satellite testing, simulation and communication

[ Talk to our experts ][76]
Our services

## C-STS: Trustworthy Engineering for Tailor-Made Solutions in Simulation, Testing, and
## Communication

With over three decades of experience, Celestia STS (C-STS) is a trusted name in the European and
international space industry. Since our founding in 1985, we have specialized in delivering
ground-based solutions for satellite simulation, testing, communication, and data processing.

As a center of excellence for Electrical Ground Support Equipment ([EGSE][77]), [TT&C solutions][78]
and [Optical Modems][79], we have earned an outstanding reputation for flexibility and high-quality
engineering. Our systems are vital to a wide range of space missions and are used in diverse
environments—from institutional laboratories and spacecraft integration facilities to operational
(optical) ground stations for missions like Galileo, [EAGLE-1][80] and the ESA Copernicus
satellites.

Our legacy is built on a history of success, having contributed to over 80% of major European Space
Agency missions. As we continue to expand and innovate, our dedicated team is committed to
delivering the reliable, high-performance solutions that ensure your satellite works perfectly.

[more about us][81]

At Embention, we have been pioneers in autopilots and critical avionics systems for autonomous
vehicles. Approved as **POA** and **APDOA** organization. Compliance
with **DO178C**, **DO254** and **DO160G** standards for aircraft certification.

## Veronte Autopilot

Revolutionizing autopilot systems for **UNMANNED DRONES & PASSENGER eVTOL**

### 1x

[Autopilot 1x][Autopilot 1x]

Programmable control system for drones, UGVs and USVs including sensor redundancy.

[More info][57]

### 4x

[Autopilot 4x][Autopilot 4x]

Core redundant autopilot system for large UAVs and manned eVTOL certification.

[More info][58]

### DRx

[Autopilot DRx][Autopilot DRx]

Distributed redundant autopilot for controlling autonomous flight and fly-by-wire.

[More info][59]

## FAQs

### What is Embention and what solutions does it offer for drones and eVTOLs? ▾

Since 2007, we’ve been pioneers in autopilots and safety-critical avionics for autonomous vehicles,
leading the UAS and eVTOL components sector. We develop high-performance avionics for Urban Air
Mobility in compliance with DO-178C, DO-254, and DO-160 standards, and we hold POA and APDOA
approvals. Embention is certified to ISO 9001, EN 9100, and the ISO/IEC 27001 cybersecurity
standard, enabling drones to populate our skies.

### What is Veronte Autopilot and what advantages does it offer for drones and eVTOLs? ▾

Veronte Autopilot is a customizable control system for autonomous vehicles and fly-by-wire aircraft.
Suitable for UAVs, USVs, UGVs, and eVTOLs in multiple configurations, it’s developed in compliance
with DO-178C / ED-12, DO-254 / ED-80, and DO-160G.

including drones, USVs, UGVs, and eVTOLs in various configurations. Our PDI engineering team advises
on system architecture design and component selection, and supports simulation phases as well as
ground and flight testing.

**About us**







Shenzhen Haike Technology Co., Ltd. is a professional manufacturer integrating design, R&D,
production, sales and service. Since 2014, it has focused on UAV flight control boards (FPV flight
control, APM, PIX and closed-source flight controllers); brushless ESCs and brushless drive
controllers for FPV flying machines, fixed-wing aircraft, car models, ship models, etc.; RC model
peripheral products such as RC receivers, digital transmission modules, and GPS; R&D and production
of drives such as mechanical dogs and robotic arms. The company adheres to the business philosophy
of "seeking development through science and technology, seeking benefits through quality" and is
committed to providing professional and efficient one-stop services in software development,
hardware design and production for complete machine companies and parts traders.


The company now has a top high-tech R & D team. It has obtained 8 patents in the attitude stability
control algorithm, software development and motor drive algorithm design of the aircraft. Our own
brand products have obtained CE and 3C With certification certificates, we always keep up with
market demand, develop popular products, and provide customers with comprehensive and professional
customized services as well as safe and worry-free after-sales guarantee.


Follow ISO, IPC standards. Online SPI, AOI, X-Ray, etc., ensuring product qualification rate of
99.9%.

Leaded and lead-free solders are used to assemble the PCB from rigid and flexible boards to
soft-hard combined boards. The PCB uses high-end multi-layer thickened copper skin and applies
high-end resin mesh PCB production technology to ensure product reliability.



There are 2 fully automatic SMT assembly lines, 4 DIP and finished product assembly and testing
lines, with a daily production capacity of 20,000 pieces.

A comprehensive and reliable supplier of original components, responsible for product performance
from the source.

24/7 on-site sales and technical support to respond to customer needs at all times.

**About us**







Shenzhen Haike Technology Co., Ltd. is a professional manufacturer integrating design, R&D,
production, sales and service. Since 2014, it has focused on UAV flight control boards (FPV flight
control, APM, PIX and closed-source flight controllers); brushless ESCs and brushless drive
controllers for FPV flying machines, fixed-wing aircraft, car models, ship models, etc.; RC model
peripheral products such as RC receivers, digital transmission modules, and GPS; R&D and production
of drives such as mechanical dogs and robotic arms. The company adheres to the business philosophy
of "seeking development through science and technology, seeking benefits through quality" and is
committed to providing professional and efficient one-stop services in software development,
hardware design and production for complete machine companies and parts traders.


The company now has a top high-tech R & D team. It has obtained 8 patents in the attitude stability
control algorithm, software development and motor drive algorithm design of the aircraft. Our own
brand products have obtained CE and 3C With certification certificates, we always keep up with
market demand, develop popular products, and provide customers with comprehensive and professional
customized services as well as safe and worry-free after-sales guarantee.


Follow ISO, IPC standards. Online SPI, AOI, X-Ray, etc., ensuring product qualification rate of
99.9%.

Leaded and lead-free solders are used to assemble the PCB from rigid and flexible boards to
soft-hard combined boards. The PCB uses high-end multi-layer thickened copper skin and applies
high-end resin mesh PCB production technology to ensure product reliability.



There are 2 fully automatic SMT assembly lines, 4 DIP and finished product assembly and testing
lines, with a daily production capacity of 20,000 pieces.

A comprehensive and reliable supplier of original components, responsible for product performance
from the source.

24/7 on-site sales and technical support to respond to customer needs at all times.

### QGroundControl

##### Intuitive and Powerful Ground Control Station for the MAVLink protocol.

[Learn More][18][Download][19]

QGroundControl provides full flight control and mission planning for any MAVLink enabled drone. Its
primary goal is ease of use for professional users and developers. All the code is open-source
source, so you can contribute and evolve it as you want.

### Platforms

QGroundControl runs on Windows, OS X, Linux, iOS and Android

### Autopilots

Supports multiple autopilots: PX4 Pro, ArduPilot or any vehicle that communicates using the MAVLink
protocol

### Vehicles

Works with all vehicle types supported by PX4 Pro and ArduPilot (multi-rotor, fixed-wing, VTOL,
etc.)

QGroundControl runs on Windows, OS X, Linux, iOS and Android

Supports multiple autopilots: PX4 Pro, ArduPilot or any vehicle that communicates using the MAVLink

# Simplifying Satellite Ground Operations

Software-defined ground systems that replace legacy hardware — making space operations faster,
smarter, and accessible to missions worldwide.

[Contact us →][27] [Learn about Remos][28]

## Breaking the hardware barrier.

For decades, ground segments have been the bottleneck — rigid, expensive, and exclusive. We
dismantle this barrier by moving operations entirely to software, letting you bypass procurement
cycles and deploy missions fast.

## Recognized by NASA for advancing software-defined ground technology.

> "The Expedite software modem by Remos Space Systems performs real-time demodulation, decoding,
> encoding, and frame synchronization in compliance with CCSDS standards — used across government,
> commercial, and academic ground stations worldwide."

— NASA, State-of-the-Art Small Spacecraft Technology Report, 2026
[
**Read the 2026 report** NASA · State-of-the-Art Small Spacecraft Technology
chevron_right ][29]

## Software Modems

Whether you're building a small IoT CubeSat or sending a probe deep into space, Remos modems can
support your satellite mission.
01 Adaptive

### Expedite

Adaptive TT&C Software Modem with support for multiple NewSpace transceivers

DeployOn-prem or cloud
* Supported transceivers · Gomspace Nanocom AX100 & AX2150, Satlab, Endurosat, Cydespace, ISIS, and
  custom
* Automatic Doppler compensation
* Built-in antenna control & pass scheduler
* Frequency · 70 MHz to 2.5 GHz
* Modulations · BPSK, QPSK, FSK, GMSK, GFSK, AFSK, ASK, PCM/PM, PCM/PSK/PM
* Symbol rates · 100 Baud to 25 MBaud
* Interfaces · Remos packet interface, SLE, REST API, CFDP
* Supported protocols · CCSDS TM, CCSDS TC, NewSpace protocols

[Go to Expedite page→][30]
02 Fast

### Hasten

High-rate data download.

DeployOn-prem or cloud
* Built-in antenna control & pass scheduler
* Automatic Doppler compensation
* Frequency · 70 MHz to 2.5 GHz
* Modulations · BPSK, GMSK, QPSK, 8-PSK, 16-APSK, 32-APSK
* TM data rates · up to 315 MBaud
* Supported protocols · CCSDS TM, DVB-S2(x)

[Go to Hasten page→][31]

## Turnkey Ground Stations.

Our Plug-and-Play Ground Stations integrate with Expedite or Hasten modems to support antenna
control and mission scheduling.
[UHF/VHF/S/L-Band Ground Station dish array network for CubeSat and SmallSat missions]

### UHF/VHF/S/L-Band

Reliable multi-band performance for SmallSat missions, training programs, and rapid-deploy ground
systems.
* Integrated with Expedite Modem and Sequencer
* Available in any band config
* Turnkey antenna + controller + pass scheduler

[Explore UHF/VHF/S/L-Band→][32]
[S/X-Band Ground Station antenna for Earth observation and high-throughput downlink]

### S/X-Band

High-gain, high-throughput system engineered for Earth-observation, payload data, and precision TT&C
operations.
* Integrated with Expedite or Hasten
* Available in any polarization
* Dual-feed precision tracking for LEO & MEO

[Explore S/X-Band→][33]

### GSaaS and MCS Orchestration

Manages a network of Ground Stations using Remos modems and antennas. Connects to third-party
modems, antennas, and GSaaS networks too.
* Natively compatible with any Expedite modem
* Manages your GSaaS network and Mission Control Software
* Self-service user accounts with secure 2FA
* REST API + pass scheduler · automated ops

[ Open Umoja portal arrow_outward ][34]

## A complete space agency in a box.

Designed for institutions and emerging space nations seeking to launch their own missions. Every
essential component, packaged together.
[Explore capacity building →][35] [Contact us][36]

The sky is not the limit — ground operations can be. Remos removes those limits with support at
every stage, from mission design to on-orbit operations.

We collaborate with your team before launch to integrate our software-defined modems and APIs with
your satellite systems, ensuring seamless ground communication readiness from day one.

### Capacity building & continuous support

Beyond software, we equip institutions and emerging space nations with tools and training to operate

40%

### All-in-one cost savings.

# Safran Defense & Space, Inc.
# (formerly Safran Data Systems, Inc.)

### Leader in Instrumentation for Testing & Telemetry and Space Solutions

[Discover Our Solutions][71]
[Icon arrow down] Scroll down

Safran Defense & Space (formerly Safran Data Systems, Inc.) provides high-technology equipment and
solutions for testing, telemetry, mission data management and space solutions. With a high-skilled
international team, we contribute to the success of our customers by offering innovation, best
performance, reliability and sustainability.

## Our Solutions...

#### Space Propulsion Systems

For more sustainable satellites and spacecraft, we offer a complete range of: electric motors (wide
range of plasma thrusters to increase satellite payloads, while reducing launch and operating costs)
and propulsion subsystems (complete propulsion subsystems including PPS® Hall effect plasma
thrusters, the fluid control system and the electronic power processing unit, while also taking
charge of all required interfaces)

[LEARN MORE][72]

#### On-Board Space Communications

Safran manufactures radio communication equipment for small satellite platforms (mini, micro,
nano-cube satellites) in low earth orbit for Earth observation missions or exploration of the solar
system. Safran’s catalog is the largest on the market, with high data rate transmitters, TT&C – ISL
transponders, precise GNSS receivers, data collect payloads, spectrum monitoring payloads and OCXOs.

[LEARN MORE][73]

#### Space Optics

We design innovative instruments dedicated to Astronomy, Space, Defense and Laser Industry. Our
optomechanical components (mirror, lenses assemblies) meet the most demanding requirements of
international scientific programs for world-wide customers and for the main world Space Agencies.

[LEARN MORE][74]

#### Satellite Ground Stations and Modems

For one equipment to an end-to-end solution in Earth Observation, Scientific Missions, Small
Satellites, Constellations, and Deep Space applications, Safran Defense & Space, Inc. From tri-band
S/X/KA ground and transportable antennas to Command & Control, Ranging, and RF Recorders,
Virtualized Modems, we are able to support every step of your Space mission.

[LEARN MORE][75]

#### Space & Spectrum Domain Awareness

A growing number of objects are now in orbit, and it is critical to ensure they do not collide.
Radio-frequency F sensors, used to consolidate our knowledge of space, will thus contribute to the
peaceful and cooperative management of space. This is why WeTrack® has been developed in-house.
Operated by Safran Defense & Space, Inc. (formerly Safran Data Systems, Inc.), WeTrack® is an
autonomous network of radio frequency (RF) sensors to attain precise orbital positions with high
data update rates.

[LEARN MORE][76]

#### On-Board Data Acquisition Systems

Safran Defense & Space, Inc. (formerly Safran Data Systems, Inc.) offers a comprehensive range of
products tailored for various platforms including fixed wing, rotary wing, and eVTOL aircraft, as
well as weapons systems and space rockets/launchers. Our families of data acquisition units (XMA,
CMA) and recorders (MDR) provide essential tools for flight tests. The eZ Software Suite acts as the
linchpin, enabling seamless configuration, monitoring, and processing to ensure optimal performance
and data management.

[LEARN MORE][77]

#### Recorders, Download Stations

HEIM & CORTEX brand recorders and download stations stand as the global frontrunner for flight
testing needs that require scalability, flexibility, reliability, and dependability. These recorders
are essential for Test and Evaluation applications, whether for new or upgraded platforms, fixed and
rotary wing & eVTOL aircraft, weapons systems, space rockets/launchers.

[LEARN MORE][78]

#### RF Receivers & Transmitters

In the ever-evolving flight test campaigns, the importance of receivers and transmitters cannot be
overstated. These equipment play a pivotal role in transmitting and receiving the telemetry data
during aircraft, missile or rocket test flights. In addition to their unparalleled reliability and
exceptional precision, Safran Defense & Space, Inc. (formerly Safran Data Systems, Inc.) CORTEX
receivers conform meticulously to the most recent IRIG specifications.

[LEARN MORE][79]

#### Telemetry Tracking Antennas

Safran Defense & Space, Inc. (formerly Safran Data Systems, Inc.) has an extensive range of
telemetry tracking stations dedicated to flight test applications: from lightweight to 13-meter
tracking antennas, telemetry mission controller to data processing software.

[LEARN MORE][80]

#### Airborne Mission Data Management Systems

Safran Defense & Space, Inc. (formerly Safran Data Systems, Inc.) provides systems to enhance
mission performance through both Mission Data Recorder and Server functionality. All of our
equipment are highly ruggedized.

[LEARN MORE][81]

## Upcoming Calendar Events

[All Calendar Events][82]

## They Trust Us

Safran Defense & Space (formerly Safran Data Systems, Inc.) is a U.S Department of Defense (DOD)
supplier offering a complete range of specialized sensor and recording equipment for aircraft
testing and mission operations, rocket and missile test and launch monitoring, as well as providing
a myriad of ground and airborne avionics equipment specific for DOD aerospace test range operations.
Safran Defense & Space (formerly Safran Data Systems, Inc.) provides ground equipment for satellite
tracking across the commercial, civil, and DOD space industry from new space companies, to
universities, the US Space Force, and NASA.

# Safran Defense & Space, Inc.
# (formerly Safran Data Systems, Inc.)

### Leader in Instrumentation for Testing & Telemetry and Space Solutions

[Discover Our Solutions][71]
[Icon arrow down] Scroll down

Safran Defense & Space (formerly Safran Data Systems, Inc.) provides high-technology equipment and
solutions for testing, telemetry, mission data management and space solutions. With a high-skilled
international team, we contribute to the success of our customers by offering innovation, best
performance, reliability and sustainability.

## Our Solutions...

#### Space Propulsion Systems

For more sustainable satellites and spacecraft, we offer a complete range of: electric motors (wide
range of plasma thrusters to increase satellite payloads, while reducing launch and operating costs)
and propulsion subsystems (complete propulsion subsystems including PPS® Hall effect plasma
thrusters, the fluid control system and the electronic power processing unit, while also taking
charge of all required interfaces)

[LEARN MORE][72]

#### On-Board Space Communications

Safran manufactures radio communication equipment for small satellite platforms (mini, micro,
nano-cube satellites) in low earth orbit for Earth observation missions or exploration of the solar
system. Safran’s catalog is the largest on the market, with high data rate transmitters, TT&C – ISL
transponders, precise GNSS receivers, data collect payloads, spectrum monitoring payloads and OCXOs.

[LEARN MORE][73]

#### Space Optics

We design innovative instruments dedicated to Astronomy, Space, Defense and Laser Industry. Our
optomechanical components (mirror, lenses assemblies) meet the most demanding requirements of
international scientific programs for world-wide customers and for the main world Space Agencies.

[LEARN MORE][74]

#### Satellite Ground Stations and Modems

For one equipment to an end-to-end solution in Earth Observation, Scientific Missions, Small
Satellites, Constellations, and Deep Space applications, Safran Defense & Space, Inc. From tri-band
S/X/KA ground and transportable antennas to Command & Control, Ranging, and RF Recorders,
Virtualized Modems, we are able to support every step of your Space mission.

[LEARN MORE][75]

#### Space & Spectrum Domain Awareness

A growing number of objects are now in orbit, and it is critical to ensure they do not collide.
Radio-frequency F sensors, used to consolidate our knowledge of space, will thus contribute to the
peaceful and cooperative management of space. This is why WeTrack® has been developed in-house.
Operated by Safran Defense & Space, Inc. (formerly Safran Data Systems, Inc.), WeTrack® is an
autonomous network of radio frequency (RF) sensors to attain precise orbital positions with high
data update rates.

[LEARN MORE][76]

#### On-Board Data Acquisition Systems

Safran Defense & Space, Inc. (formerly Safran Data Systems, Inc.) offers a comprehensive range of
products tailored for various platforms including fixed wing, rotary wing, and eVTOL aircraft, as
well as weapons systems and space rockets/launchers. Our families of data acquisition units (XMA,
CMA) and recorders (MDR) provide essential tools for flight tests. The eZ Software Suite acts as the
linchpin, enabling seamless configuration, monitoring, and processing to ensure optimal performance
and data management.

[LEARN MORE][77]

#### Recorders, Download Stations

HEIM & CORTEX brand recorders and download stations stand as the global frontrunner for flight
testing needs that require scalability, flexibility, reliability, and dependability. These recorders
are essential for Test and Evaluation applications, whether for new or upgraded platforms, fixed and
rotary wing & eVTOL aircraft, weapons systems, space rockets/launchers.

[LEARN MORE][78]

#### RF Receivers & Transmitters

In the ever-evolving flight test campaigns, the importance of receivers and transmitters cannot be
overstated. These equipment play a pivotal role in transmitting and receiving the telemetry data
during aircraft, missile or rocket test flights. In addition to their unparalleled reliability and
exceptional precision, Safran Defense & Space, Inc. (formerly Safran Data Systems, Inc.) CORTEX
receivers conform meticulously to the most recent IRIG specifications.

[LEARN MORE][79]

#### Telemetry Tracking Antennas

Safran Defense & Space, Inc. (formerly Safran Data Systems, Inc.) has an extensive range of
telemetry tracking stations dedicated to flight test applications: from lightweight to 13-meter
tracking antennas, telemetry mission controller to data processing software.

[LEARN MORE][80]

#### Airborne Mission Data Management Systems

Safran Defense & Space, Inc. (formerly Safran Data Systems, Inc.) provides systems to enhance
mission performance through both Mission Data Recorder and Server functionality. All of our
equipment are highly ruggedized.

[LEARN MORE][81]

## Upcoming Calendar Events

[All Calendar Events][82]

## They Trust Us

Safran Defense & Space (formerly Safran Data Systems, Inc.) is a U.S Department of Defense (DOD)
supplier offering a complete range of specialized sensor and recording equipment for aircraft
testing and mission operations, rocket and missile test and launch monitoring, as well as providing
a myriad of ground and airborne avionics equipment specific for DOD aerospace test range operations.
Safran Defense & Space (formerly Safran Data Systems, Inc.) provides ground equipment for satellite
tracking across the commercial, civil, and DOD space industry from new space companies, to
universities, the US Space Force, and NASA.

## Welcome to Space Ground System Solutions (SGSS)

SGSS is an engineering services company that operates as a wholly owned subsidiary under Parsons
Corporation. We provide our customers with practical, state-of-the-art solutions for complex
satellite communications, command, control, and intelligence systems. We currently provide software
engineering development to the U.S. Naval Research Laboratory (NRL). This includes critical elements
of spacecraft design, integration and testing, software and device driver development, and
maintenance of the ground station. This is accomplished utilizing reliable remote tracking system
control software; mission unique software; data reduction and analysis with satellite specific
command and control (C2) software for naval field units. As of April 2024, the C2 software suite is
used to control more than 100 National Security Space (NSS) satellites, as well as provide control
and status of the ground system equipment.

SGSS also provides software engineering to maintain and grow US government capabilities in space-
and multi-domain mission and flight planning; orbital dynamics including maneuver planning; and an
array of modeling, simulation, integration and test capabilities. We continue to grow in the areas
of software-defined RF processing, cybersecurity, compliance, and IT services enabling delivery of
complete ground segment capabilities for NRL partners seeking rapid-turn research and development
enabling on-orbit innovation.

SGSS has two offices, one in Alexandria, VA and the second in West Melbourne, FL. We also support
on-site work at the NRL Campus in Washington, DC and at the Blossom Point Satellite Tracking
Facility in Blossom Point, Welcome, MD. Our West Melbourne facility has secure high speed
communication links and a secure area for systems development, test, maintenance, and enhancement.

SGSS is a highly skilled system and software engineering company. We are proud to say we have some
of the most experienced and competent engineers in the space and real-time processing industry. SGSS
is also committed to and supportive of staff growth. We offer engaging work for our IT professional
and software engineers with an unyielding focus on providing outstanding service to our customers.

### [Ground Station Applications][11]

System and software engineering services for the design and development of command, control,
tasking, and monitoring of multiple space vehicles simultaneously.

### [Flight Applications][12]

Integration and test engineering efforts in design and development of all command and telemetry
processing, test hardware specific interfaces, and test procedures required from box to system to
complete spacecraft testing.

### [Network Applications][13]

Currently supporting the development of wide area networks utilizing ATM and other high speed
technology.

### [Terrestrial Observation][14]

Design, development and field installations of real-time embedded systems to the Tactical Electronic
Warfare Division of NRL for a suite of radar monitoring and measuring systems.

## Welcome to Space Ground System Solutions (SGSS)

SGSS is an engineering services company that operates as a wholly owned subsidiary under Parsons
Corporation. We provide our customers with practical, state-of-the-art solutions for complex
satellite communications, command, control, and intelligence systems. We currently provide software
engineering development to the U.S. Naval Research Laboratory (NRL). This includes critical elements
of spacecraft design, integration and testing, software and device driver development, and
maintenance of the ground station. This is accomplished utilizing reliable remote tracking system
control software; mission unique software; data reduction and analysis with satellite specific
command and control (C2) software for naval field units. As of April 2024, the C2 software suite is
used to control more than 100 National Security Space (NSS) satellites, as well as provide control
and status of the ground system equipment.

SGSS also provides software engineering to maintain and grow US government capabilities in space-
and multi-domain mission and flight planning; orbital dynamics including maneuver planning; and an
array of modeling, simulation, integration and test capabilities. We continue to grow in the areas
of software-defined RF processing, cybersecurity, compliance, and IT services enabling delivery of
complete ground segment capabilities for NRL partners seeking rapid-turn research and development
enabling on-orbit innovation.

SGSS has two offices, one in Alexandria, VA and the second in West Melbourne, FL. We also support
on-site work at the NRL Campus in Washington, DC and at the Blossom Point Satellite Tracking
Facility in Blossom Point, Welcome, MD. Our West Melbourne facility has secure high speed
communication links and a secure area for systems development, test, maintenance, and enhancement.

SGSS is a highly skilled system and software engineering company. We are proud to say we have some
of the most experienced and competent engineers in the space and real-time processing industry. SGSS
is also committed to and supportive of staff growth. We offer engaging work for our IT professional
and software engineers with an unyielding focus on providing outstanding service to our customers.

### [Ground Station Applications][11]

System and software engineering services for the design and development of command, control,
tasking, and monitoring of multiple space vehicles simultaneously.

### [Flight Applications][12]

Integration and test engineering efforts in design and development of all command and telemetry
processing, test hardware specific interfaces, and test procedures required from box to system to
complete spacecraft testing.

### [Network Applications][13]

Currently supporting the development of wide area networks utilizing ATM and other high speed
technology.

### [Terrestrial Observation][14]

Design, development and field installations of real-time embedded systems to the Tactical Electronic
Warfare Division of NRL for a suite of radar monitoring and measuring systems.

# Spacecraft Operations
# and Engineering Services

We provide engineering, operations and consultancy services to the international space market. With
more than 35 years of experience in engineering services, we can support any space mission, be it
earth observations, telecommunications, navigation, interplanetary, astronomical, or manned
spaceflights.

[Read More][115]

# and Rocket Test Services

tests of fully reusable launch vehicles, and we are building orbital launch capabilities at Esrange
Space Center.

* Real-time satellite propagation using SGP4/SDP4 orbital mechanics

### How can I track the International Space Station (ISS) in real time?

Track The Sky displays the [ISS][36] position on an interactive 3D globe, updated every second using
orbital data from CelesTrak and NORAD. Click on the ISS to view its current altitude, speed, sunlit
status, and predicted next pass times for your location.

### What satellites can I see with the naked eye tonight?

The Naked Eye Visibility feature estimates which satellites are bright enough to see without a
telescope, based on their visual magnitude. Set your observer location and Track The Sky calculates
the best viewing times using your position and the sun angle to find sunlit satellites against a
dark sky.

### How many Starlink satellites are in orbit?

Track The Sky tracks all active [Starlink][37] satellites in the public NORAD catalog, currently
numbering over 6,000 and growing with each SpaceX launch. The dedicated Starlink Train Detector
feature identifies recently launched batches that are still visible as a bright chain of lights in
the night sky.

### How do I find out when the ISS will pass over my location?

Use the Observer Location feature to set your position via geolocation, manual coordinates, or a
preset city list. Track The Sky then calculates upcoming pass times, maximum elevation, and approach
direction for the [ISS][38] or any other satellite you select.

### What is satellite orbital tracking?

Satellites follow elliptical paths around Earth governed by orbital mechanics, and their positions
are predicted using TLE or OMM data sets published by NORAD. Track The Sky uses the satellite.js
library to run SGP4 propagation, converting those element sets into precise latitude, longitude, and
altitude coordinates in real time.

### How accurate is real-time satellite tracking?

Tracking data comes from CelesTrak, which distributes official NORAD orbital element sets updated
multiple times per day. Track The Sky refreshes this data every two hours and uses SGP4 propagation,
which is accurate to within a few kilometers for low-Earth-orbit satellites over short prediction
windows.

### Can I track military or spy satellites?

Track The Sky displays every satellite listed in the public NORAD catalog, which includes many
[military satellites][39] such as [GPS][40], SBIRS, and some reconnaissance platforms. However,
classified satellites that are not published in the public catalog cannot be tracked by any civilian
tool.

### What is the Starlink train and how can I see it?

After each SpaceX launch, newly deployed [Starlink][41] satellites fly in a closely spaced formation
known as a "Starlink train" before gradually spreading into their operational orbits. Track The
Sky's Starlink Train Detector identifies these recently launched batches and shows when the train is
visible from your location.

### How do I share a satellite's location with someone?

Click on any satellite to select it, then copy the URL from your browser address bar — it
automatically includes the satellite's NORAD ID (for example, trackthesky.com/satellite/25544 for
the [ISS][42]). Anyone who opens that link will see the same satellite highlighted on the 3D globe.

### Is Track The Sky free to use?

Yes, Track The Sky is completely free with no account or sign-up required. All orbital data is
sourced from CelesTrak's open data feeds, so you can track satellites, predict passes, and explore
space without any cost.

# German Engineering –Made in the EU

## We enable state-of-the art antenna systems, precisely tailored with lasting quality. Our mission:
## Leading-edge technology, supported by international engineering expertise, customer focus, a
## strong employee culture,environmental awareness and fair cooperation.

# Solutions & Systems

## Innovative antenna systems for global,lunar, and deep-space applications.

[Discover more][21]

# Technology & Components

## Advanced innovations for antenna systems.

[Discover more][22]

# Reference Projects

## In use worldwide – our systems servingscience and space exploration.

[Discover more][23]

## Our Solutions

Vertex is your specialist for high-precision antenna systems and ground stations in the fields of
SatCom, remote sensing, and TT&C.
From S-band to Q/V-band, for fixed, mobile, and transportable applications, we deliver customized,
ISO-certified solutions that reliably meet mission-critical requirements worldwide.

[Discover more][24]

## Technologies

Our antenna systems are based on state-of-the-art high-end technologies, including multi-band
capability, highly rigid structures, and RF systems up to over 50 GHz. They enable milligrad
alignment accuracy even in the most demanding applications. In deep-space and mission-critical
scenarios, they represent European innovation and German manufacturing quality, designed for
durability, energy efficiency, and future-proofing.

[Discover more][25]

## Plug & Play Systems

Our innovative modular antenna systems follow a consistent plug-and-play approach and cover
diameters from 5.5 m to 13.5 m. Prefabricated, integrated, and tested in Germany, they reduce
installation effort by up to 80%. Precise engineering ensures superior tracking performance for GEO,
MEO, and LEO missions.

[Discover more][26]

## Our Core Applications

#### Remote Sensing and LEO

[Discover more >][27]

#### TT&C ground stations

[Discover more >][28]

#### Defense

[Discover more >][29]

#### Multi Orbit Satellite Constellations

[Discover more >][30]

#### Near and Deep Space

[Discover more >][31]

#### Radio Telescopes

[Discover more >][32]

#### Aftersales and Upgrades

[Discover more >][33]

### Radar

[Discover more >][34]

### Deep Space & Lunar Communication

## Deep Space & Lunar Communication

### For Advanced Space Exploration and Observation

The systems are designed for maximum accuracy, availability, and long-term stability in
mission-critical environments. As part of Kongsberg Satellite Services’ (KSAT) global Lunar Ground
Station Network, three 20-meter dual-band antennas (X-/Ka-band) were commissioned. These enable
continuous lunar coverage as well as TT&C, payload downlink, and ranging, and form a central
infrastructure for future lunar and deep-space missions.

[Discover more][35]

## Plug & Play Antennas

### Pre-assembled high-precision antenna systems:

With our new, efficient Plug-&-Play antenna system, CPI Vertex Antennentechnik significantly
streamlines your construction site processes.

[Discover more][36]

## Configurator

### Simple, interactive, and precise – for your mission

Put together your ideal ground station in just a few steps: Select antenna size, frequency bands,
tracking modes, and RF components. Based on our expertise, you’ll then receive a quote—revolutionize
SatCom and deep-space communication.

[Configure now][37]

## Technologies

Our antenna systems are based on state-of-the-art high-end technologies, including multi-band
capability, highly rigid structures, and RF systems up to over 50 GHz. They enable milligrad
alignment accuracy even in the most demanding applications. In deep-space and mission-critical
scenarios, they represent European innovation and German manufacturing quality, designed for
durability, energy efficiency, and future-proofing.

## Plug & Play Systems

Our innovative modular antenna systems follow a consistent plug-and-play approach and cover
diameters from 5.5 m to 13.5 m. Prefabricated, integrated, and tested in Germany, they reduce
installation effort by up to 80%. Precise engineering ensures superior tracking performance for GEO,
MEO, and LEO missions.

## Deep Space & Lunar Communication

### For Advanced Space Exploration and Observation

The systems are designed for maximum accuracy, availability, and long-term stability in
mission-critical environments. As part of Kongsberg Satellite Services’ (KSAT) global Lunar Ground
Station Network, three 20-meter dual-band antennas (X-/Ka-band) were commissioned. These enable
continuous lunar coverage as well as TT&C, payload downlink, and ranging, and form a central
infrastructure for future lunar and deep-space missions.
